event_info.event_description: Analyze for disclosures on global pandemic risks. Look for corporate language discussing widespread impacts like supply chain disruptions, labor shortages, remote work transitions, and fundamental shifts in consumer demand.

holistic_analysis: AMD’s 2024 filing explicitly frames COVID-19 as an ongoing, enterprise-wide threat that can still materially harm the company through workforce impacts, supply-chain disruptions, higher costs and operational constraints. Although the first wave of the pandemic began almost four years prior, the disclosure treats the risk as persisting—using present-tense verbs such as “have and may continue to adversely affect.”  The language is largely qualitative and contingency-oriented (no quantified dollar amounts), but it goes beyond boiler-plate by listing concrete channels of exposure: travel bans, lockdowns, vaccination requirements, employee productivity loss and supplier interruptions.  Under the Time Decay Principle, COVID-19 now falls at the early edge of the 4-to-10-year “medium-term” window, so individual evidence scores should cluster in the moderate range (4-6) when the wording is specific and direct, and lower when the statement is generic.  Overall, the risk is still treated as potentially material but with uncertainty and no fresh financial metrics, warranting moderate—not extreme—severity ratings.

evidence_list.snippet: We are subject to risks associated with public health crises, such as pandemics and epidemics.

components.reason: Acknowledges exposure to public-health crises and pandemics as a corporate risk.
Generic wording with no mention of COVID-19 or specific impacts.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Generic recognition of pandemic risk earns a low score because it lacks COVID-19 specificity or stated impacts.

evidence_list.snippet: We are subject to risks associated with public health crises, such as pandemics and epidemics, including the COVID-19 pandemic, which may have a material adverse effect on our business.

components.reason: Warns of a potentially “material adverse effect” on the business.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Direct reference to COVID-19 and use of materiality language place this sentence in the mid-range severity bracket.

evidence_list.snippet: Global health outbreaks, such as COVID-19, have and may continue to adversely affect our employees, disrupt our business operations and practices, as well those of our customers, partners, vendors and suppliers.

components.reason: States that COVID-19 already HAS adversely affected personnel and operations (actual impact).
Lists multiple affected stakeholder groups and operational domains, indicating breadth of exposure.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Describes real and ongoing adverse effects across the value chain, justifying a strong mid-range score.

evidence_list.snippet: Public health measures by government authorities such as travel bans, social-distancing, lockdown measures, vaccination requirements may cause us to incur additional costs, limit our operations, modify our business practices, diminish employee productivity or disrupt our supply chain, which may have a material adverse effect on our business.

components.reason: Enumerates concrete mechanisms (travel bans, lockdowns, etc.) that can disrupt operations and supply chains.
Highlights financial (additional costs) and productivity impacts.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Specific operational and cost risks drive the score, but lack of quantified numbers keeps it moderate.

evidence_list.snippet: To the extent a public health crisis will impact our business, financial condition and results of operations depends on factors outside of our control, including severity, duration and the measures to contain the health outbreak.

components.reason: Acknowledges that a public-health crisis can affect business, financial condition and results.
Emphasizes uncertainty and external dependence, which mitigates perceived immediacy.
Still frames the potential impact across all key financial dimensions.

evidence_list.reasoning_summary: Conditional and forward-looking wording with no specifics results in a low severity score.
